name: Lyo.Cli pack/install
tagline: Pack and install the global `lyo` dotnet tool from Lyo.Cli.
description: Thin wrapper around `dotnet pack` / `dotnet tool install|update|uninstall` for the PackAsTool project under Lyo.Net/Tools/Lyo.Cli. Library NuGet packs still skip Tools/; use this script for the CLI tool package.

commands.blurb: dotnet tool install -g Lyo.Cli from artifacts/cli
Force-reinstall global Lyo.Cli from artifacts/cli (same version OK)
Pack then force-reinstall the global tool (needed when version stays 1.0.0)

notes: Default version is 1.0.0 (`-v`); nupkg dir defaults to artifacts/cli or LYO_CLI_NUPKG_DIR
pack-install / update uninstall then install so rebuilding 1.0.0 still refreshes the tool (`dotnet tool update` no-ops on same version)
